accounting_rules.nested_operator_warning: aten::to launches aten::_to_copy, which launches aten::copy_, which launches the CUDA copy kernel. Their CUDA times are the same work and must not be added. Kernel self-time and aten::copy_ CUDA time match and are the ground truth.
accounting_rules.kernel_parenting_limitation: CUDA kernels (bfloat16_copy, direct_copy) have empty stacks and no CPU parent, so automatic phase/module/kind on kernel events is unknown/unattributed/F_other. Attribution uses aten::copy_ shape groups plus the Python Tensor.to tracer.
accounting_rules.backward_parenting_limitation: torch.autograd launches are not children of the phase/backward record_function, so backward copies appear as phase=unknown.

kernel_ground_truth.note: Self-time of copy/cast CUDA kernels. Matches Phase 3.4 copy_cast 256.0275 ms/step.

variants.interpretation: Bulk contiguous FP32<->BF16 activation / residual / Linear-boundary casts. This is the Phase 3.4 top kernel.
QKV adapter query/key/value.to(autocast_dtype). Matches the 72/step Python-visible FP32->BF16 [2048,8,16,64] site and the forward/attention aten::copy_ group.

Non-vectorizable dtype conversion (cast load/store). Same aten::copy_ / aten::_to_copy sites as bfloat16_copy when TensorIterator cannot use the vectorized bfloat16 path (mixed layout, non-contiguous, or less regular shapes).
Integer label/layout copies in the loss path.

unique_copy_sites.note: One row per distinct aten::copy_ (phase, module, shape). Do not sum aten::to and aten::_to_copy with these numbers.

sites.interpretation: MLP FFN-width activations. 24 of the 120 total [2048,8,4096] copies are the parented mlp_fc2 forward site below. Python tracer proves 24/step BF16->FP32 grad_output.to(ctx.input_dtype) in ColumnParallelLinear backward (linear_fc1). Remaining C++ autocast / autograd casts of the same shape are not Python-visible.
Hidden / residual stream. 145 = 24 layers * 6 + 1 extra (embedding or final LN). Includes residual BF16->FP32 upcasts and Linear input FP32->BF16 autocast of hidden-width tensors.
Flattened B*S x FFN (8*2048=16384). MLP FC2 input / equivalent GEMM operand cast. 24/step = once per layer.
Transpose of the flattened FFN operand. Matches dgrad / wgrad layout conversion, one per layer.
Forward Linear autocast of MLP FC2 input (FP32 residual-stream activation -> BF16 GEMM operand).
Explicit QKV adapter. 24 layers * Q,K,V. Maps 1:1 onto the 72-launch elementwise bfloat16_copy (13.14 ms/step).
Matching backward of the QKV adapter casts (autograd of Tensor.to). Same shape and call count as the forward adapter.
Fused QKV GEMM operand 3H x (B*S). Activation or dgrad layout, not the stored parameter [3072,1024].
Fused QKV projection output [S,B,3H]. 48/step = 2 per layer (forward autocast and matching backward).

unique_copy_sites.note_unlisted: aten::copy_ totals 255.92 ms/step. The top unique sites above cover ~196 ms. The remainder is smaller weight/bias/norm/loss copies that did not enter the top operator groups.

phase_split.note: GPU copy/cast ground truth is 255.91 ms/step of kernel self-time. Raw profiler by_phase CUDA times charge nested aten::to/_to_copy/copy_ plus unparented kernels and are not additive.

additional_forward_python_sites: C++ Linear autocast of hidden/FFN activations launched from forward (shapes above, often phase=unknown because the kernel has no CPU parent)

backward.interpretation: Most remaining unparented activation-shaped copies are backward dtype conversions of Linear operands and residual casts.

optimizer.interpretation: AdamW is already FP32. These are CPU-side copy ops with no GPU copy kernel. Phase 3.4 optimizer GPU time (53.06 ms/step) is addcmul/Adam math, not copy/cast.

module_split.note: Raw by_module CUDA times nest aten::to/_to_copy/copy_ and over-count. Unique parented aten::copy_ rows are preferred. Python tracer supplies sites that module hooks missed (residual BDA is not a named Linear/LN module).

unique_or_traced.note: Megatron documents this as the FP32 residual-stream upcast. 72/step = 3 per layer. self_attn_bda and mlp_bda are two of the sites; the tracer groups every same-shape BF16->FP32 Tensor.to with this stack.
C++ Linear autocast / dgrad of fused QKV. Python tracer does not see these.
Small in the parented set; hidden-width copies of this module are mostly unparented.
Weight [1024] FP32->BF16 3/step; hidden [2048,8,1024] FP32->BF16 1/step at final LN. Not dominant.

python_tracer.note: Python Tensor.to/copy_/contiguous only. C++ autocast inside aten::linear / TensorIterator is missing here.

groups.classifier_note: The capture script labeled this C_gradient_dtype_or_loss_upcast. That is incorrect: this is a residual-stream activation upcast, kind B.

groups.source: TE LayerNorm maybe_dequantize(input_.contiguous(), dtype) at final_layernorm

A_fp32_param_to_bf16.evidence: Python-visible only as TE LayerNorm weight [1024] 3/step. Stored Linear weights [3072,1024], [1024,1024], [4096,1024], [1024,4096] did not appear in the top aten::copy_ groups. Top GEMM-looking shapes are activation layouts ([3072,16384], [16384,4096]), not parameter storage.
A_fp32_param_to_bf16.ms_per_step: small; not the 161.6 ms bulk bfloat16_copy

B_activation_dtype.evidence: Residual BF16->FP32, Linear input FP32->BF16, QKV adapter FP32->BF16, FFN-width activation casts. This is the bulk of bfloat16_copy and most of direct_copy.

C_gradient_dtype.evidence: LinearFunction.backward grad_output.to(input_dtype) 24/step [2048,8,4096]; QKV adapter backward 72/step 12.85 ms; [4096,16384] dgrad layout 17.09 ms.

E_optimizer_related.evidence: 0 ms GPU copy. 876 CPU copy ops/step.

F_other.evidence: Automatic profiler kind was F_other only because CUDA kernels have empty stacks. After shape + Python tracer attribution, the bulk is B, not F.

bfloat16_copy.root_cause: FP32 residual / hidden stream mixed with BF16 autocast compute. PyTorch TensorIterator picks the vectorized bfloat16_copy kernel for contiguous FP32<->BF16 copies.

bulk_sources: C++ Linear autocast of activation operands (hidden [2048,8,1024], FFN [2048,8,4096], flattened [16384,4096])
Matching backward activation/gradient dtype conversions of those same tensors

direct_copy.pytorch_operator: aten::to -> aten::_to_copy -> aten::copy_ -> at::native::direct_copy_kernel_cuda with LoadWithCast/StoreWithCast
direct_copy.root_cause: Same dtype-conversion sites as bfloat16_copy when TensorIterator cannot use the vectorized bfloat16 kernel: non-contiguous / transposed GEMM operands ([4096,16384], [3072,16384]) and other cast-load/store copies. Not a memcpy and not optimizer traffic.

category_overlap.conclusion: Phase 3.4 copy/cast and activation/elementwise categories do not overlap. bfloat16_copy and direct_copy are exclusive to copy/cast. The 27.47% activation/elementwise bucket is GELU/add/dropout/addcmul functors, not these copy kernels.

recommended_phase_4_2_optimization.title: Keep the transformer hidden/residual stream in BF16 while leaving FP32 parameter storage unchanged
recommended_phase_4_2_optimization.rationale: The dominant copy/cast cost is activation ping-pong: FP32 residual -> BF16 Linear/attention -> BF16->FP32 residual add. Keeping hidden states in BF16 after embedding (upcast only at loss) removes residual x.to(residual.dtype), most Linear activation autocasts, and the 161.6 ms vectorized bfloat16_copy bulk. The QKV adapter is only 13.14 ms/step and is not the first lever. Caching BF16 weights alone would miss the residual stream.
recommended_phase_4_2_optimization.validation_when_promising: Only after the change looks promising: 20 warmup + 100-step A/B on the same A40 config.
